items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, he played with Trent's band. ... Somewhere I've got a picture of that Speed Webb band, which was operating the same time as Trent.

ctx.x: Yeah, he played with Trent's band. Trent played the piano and Stuff stood in front of the band with a violin. That was based in Dallas. That's a lot of jazz town. You know, the Johnson Brothers came out of Dallas, Keg and Bud.
